title: Book Three · Chapter 160: The Ten-Yuan Answer
story:
On Friday, Ronan and Kai work at a library table after school.

Kai has a written task of his own. Ronan has the sample order from the coastal centre. Practice Order is printed at the top.

There are three boxes at six yuan each. Delivery costs two more. The customer has already paid ten.

Ronan writes eighteen, then takes ten away.

“Eight left to pay,” he says.

Kai looks at the page while he rests his pencil.

“Does the box walk there?”

Ronan looks up.

Kai points to the delivery line.

“That part.”

Ronan reads it again. He adds the two yuan to eighteen. The whole order costs twenty, and ten is already paid. He takes a clean scrap and writes each part below the last: boxes, delivery, money already paid.

“Ten left.”

Kai nods and goes back to his own page.

Ronan writes the answer as a full sentence: The customer still needs to pay ten yuan.

Then he checks every line against it. He has included the delivery this time.

Kai finishes his first paragraph and asks him to read it. The idea is clear, but one sentence has no person in it.

“Who does this part?” Ronan asks.

Kai says the answer aloud, then puts the person into the sentence. He reads the whole paragraph again. He puts a small dot beside the changed line for later.

They work quietly for a while. Near the end, Ronan takes out the local centre's notice. A new sheet gives a starting date for the six Saturday mornings, three weeks from now.

He looks at the eighteen-yuan fee, then at his unfinished school work.

“I won't join this class now,” he says.

“The short one?”

“Yes. I want to finish my school tasks and find out more about the longer programme.”

He puts the local notice at the back of his folder. He has not booked a place or paid a fee.

Kai closes his book.

“And now?”

Ronan looks at the clock. They have time for a few passes before home.

“Your ball?”

“Under the chair.”

Kai reaches for it. Ronan puts the sample order away with its corrected answer.

Outside, he waits while Kai ties a loose lace. Then they walk toward the field.

“Ten yuan,” Kai says.

“I know.”

“I only asked for a pass.”

Ronan laughs and stops the ball with his shoe. He sends it back along the grass, far from any delivery line on the page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

delivery＝送货；include＝包含、计入；paragraph＝段落；corrected＝已改正的。

## 理解问题

1. 例题中为什么应付余额是十元而非八元？这是Ronan实际新增收入吗？
2. 他怎样处理本地短课的新开课信息？Kai和他各给了对方什么具体帮助？

## 读句子

**He has included the delivery this time.**

拆开看：He / has included / the delivery / this time.

他／已经计入／送货费用／这一次。
